title: Across the counter
passage: A. The counter is covered with plates. B. Both people are behind the counter. C. A customer is washing a window. D. A mug is resting on the counter.
passageZh:
A. 櫃檯上擺滿盤子。
B. 兩個人都在櫃檯後方。
C. 一位顧客正在清洗窗戶。
D. 櫃檯上放著一只馬克杯。
